title: Brand / Design Preset (synthetic-only contract)
description: Clean-room, idea-only brand/design preset shape. This schema describes a SHAPE the szh-ppt-master pipeline could one day project onto a design_system.json; it is NOT a runtime preset application contract. The runtime today resolves design tokens via templates/<name>/theme.json and scripts/init_design_system.py only; no script reads a brand_preset.json. The schema deliberately refuses real-brand wording, external URLs, file:// or data: URI schemes, absolute paths, '..' segments, public-upload wording, image-generation prompts, and raw-source / business-confidential wording at the field-shape level. A read-only stdlib-only validator ships at scripts/validate_brand_preset.py and re-applies the same gates plus a small denylist of well-known real-brand tokens, a public-hosting marker (`public` co-occurring with `host` / `hosted` / `hosting` is refused alongside the existing upload / share / publish / distribut verbs), and a validator-only credential-shape denylist (qualifier-prefixed token compounds, `secret`, `bearer`, `password`, the bare marker `token`, plus `sk-...`-prefixed API-key shapes; the schema has no field-shape pattern for credential wording, so these gates run at the validator layer alone). See references/brand-preset-contract.md for the policy envelope.

schema_version.description: Preset schema version. Bump only with a paired contract change.

preset_id.description: Stable identifier. Forced to start with the literal prefix 'synthetic_' so a preset can never be authored under a real brand id; the rest is lowercase ASCII letters, digits, and underscore. The prefix is a fail-closed gate against real-brand authorship at the schema layer, mirrored by the validator denylist.

display_name.description: Human-readable label. The pattern excludes punctuation that real brand marks frequently use (registered / trademark glyphs, parentheses, ampersand, dot, comma, slash, colon) and excludes URL-like shapes; the validator additionally enforces a real-brand denylist and refuses URL-shaped values.

runtime_status.description: Hard literal. This field locks the document at the SHAPE-only contract layer — there is no 'runtime' / 'applied' state today. The literal mirrors the contract envelope documented in references/brand-preset-contract.md and is asserted again by the validator so a future runtime path cannot quietly read a non_runtime_contract preset as if it were applied.

palette_tokens.description: Closed set of palette tokens. The token NAMES are fixed (no free-form keys via additionalProperties: false); the VALUES are constrained to 6-digit hex colors so neither URLs nor named-color brand wording can slip in. Mirrors the palette shape in schemas/design_system.schema.json so a projection helper, if ever written, would be straightforward.

typography_tokens.description: Closed set of typography tokens. heading/body each carry a CSS-style font fallback chain plus a positive numeric point size. The pattern excludes URL-shaped or path-shaped values; the validator additionally refuses any token whose first entry matches a real-brand denylist.

font_family.description: CSS-style fallback chain, preferred -> fallback. The pattern excludes punctuation typical of URLs (':', '/', '?', '#'), path separators ('\\'), and quotes; only ASCII letters, digits, hyphen, and a single space inside each entry are allowed.

spacing_style.description: Closed enum. A hint about visual density; the runtime DOES NOT apply it today.

radius_style.description: Closed enum. A hint about corner radius style; the runtime DOES NOT apply it today.

chart_style_hints.description: Closed set of chart-style hints. The runtime has NO chart rendering today (chart_placeholder fails closed); this block is shape-only and the validator refuses URL / path / real-brand wording.

allowed_layout_mood.description: Closed enum set. Captures the layout-mood subset a preset opts into; e.g. an analytical preset might allow ['analytical', 'minimal']. Used as a SHAPE hint only — no runtime layout selector reads it today.

notes.description: Optional short author note. The validator refuses URL-shaped values, file:// or data: URIs, real-brand denylist matches, public-upload wording (now including `public` co-occurring with `host` / `hosted` / `hosting`), image-generation prompt wording, raw-source / business-confidential wording, and credential-shaped wording (qualifier-prefixed token compounds like `access_token` / `api_token`, the bare marker `token`, plus `secret` / `bearer` / `password` and `sk-...`-prefixed API-key shapes). Keep it terse and synthetic.
